name: heterogeneous-node-lowering

protocol.note: Preferred Metal path: GPU encodes one ConcurrentDispatch ICB command per published task, binds a distinct ICB-capable compute PSO per authorized node class, then executeCommandsInBuffer. The host does not read class counts before execute. Selected node classes are compared against reference::select_tier2_nodes as a sorted multiset. Bucket + per-class dispatchThreadgroupsWithIndirectBuffer remains the fallback if ICB allocate/encode/execute is unavailable, and must stay EmulatedDevicePass. A post-wait readback (last_selected_node_classes) is verification only.

correctness.tolerance: exact (sorted multiset of selected node classes; unauthorized class is a hard refuse)

judgement: Metal prefers a GPU-encoded ICB: one compute command per task, a distinct ICB-capable PSO per authorized class, executeCommandsInBuffer, classified DevicePass. Uniform (4+4) and skewed (7+1) selected-class multisets must match the CPU oracle. An unauthorized class is refused. ICB allocate/encode/execute failure falls back to bucket + per-class indirect and stays EmulatedDevicePass -- that fallback is not relabeled DevicePass. The reference backend host-walks the same graph and reports Serialized. Tier3 stays Unsupported. No hitch or cost curve is claimed.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/038/041); comments in vulkan_device_hal.{h,cpp} document DGC-or-bucket as the analogue and are not wired to request_tier2_select
